B4 · two consecutive driven moves one poll apart (POLL_MS = 2500ms), at real time

poll read (POLL_MS)
level crossfade (180ms)
node box · pop (slow)
pop
pop
node box + ring · breath

01 s2 s2.5 s3 s4 s

Verdict, judged at real size: ONE move reads as calm. A pair 2.5s apart is acceptable. A sustained run of steps that each end within one poll swaps the whole level every 2.5s, and the person never finishes reading a level. That reads as restless, so it is recorded as a planning flag for the host card (MOTIR-8594). No dwell rule is invented here.

    Description

    1. Offer a Remember me checkbox under the password field. When it is ticked, the session cookie lasts 30 days instead of ending with the browser. The remembered session is bound to the device, so a stolen cookie on another browser is refused and the person signs in again.

    C6 · assistive tech — the final value, once, never per character 

    <!-- one field, while it types -->
<div class="wmde-markdown motir-prose" aria-hidden="true" data-typewriter="typing">
  <p>Offer a <strong>Remember me</strong> checkbox under the pass<span data-typewriter-caret aria-hidden="true"></span></p>
</div>
<div class="wmde-markdown motir-prose sr-only" aria-label="Work item description" data-typewriter="final">
  <p>Offer a <strong>Remember me</strong> checkbox under the password field. …</p>
  <ul>…</ul>
</div>

<!-- when it lands: the typing copy is removed, the SAME final node loses sr-only -->
<div class="wmde-markdown motir-prose" aria-label="Work item description">…</div>

    The typing copy is `aria-hidden`. The shipped final element is in the tree from the moment the field arrives, `sr-only` while the copy types, and is the same node when it lands, so a screen reader never meets a partial value and is never re-announced. No `aria-live` is added: the peek is a dialog the person is reading, not a feed.
